description: Approximate, reference-led exterior model of the current Gram GMF-C modular in-line ice-cream filling machine.
dimensionBasis: No public GMF-C dimension drawing was found. The 6.2 x 1.6 x 3.3 m installed envelope is estimated from the current manufacturer render using the HMI, working-height conveyor, leveling feet, frame tubing, and product cups as scale references. The tall utility stack establishes the maximum height; the main frame is approximately 2.25 m high.

references.use: Current machine identity, configuration, product types, modular stations, open two-side access, HMI, integrated washing, servo motion, and current exterior views.

references.type: manufacturer photograph processed as a line-art hero image
references.use: Overall three-quarter silhouette, frame bay spacing, end housings, slat conveyor, cup magazine, HMI, process stations, top cabinet, feet, and stack.
Highest-detail source for the operator side: eight-wide cup magazine and filler bank, central HMI, dry-topping hopper, closing station, blue pneumatic parts, skid and access-panel construction.

references.type: manufacturer product-range PDF mirrored by Pumps & Accessories
references.use: Earlier complete GMF-C three-quarter view and confirmation that the electrical cabinet is integrated into the frame top and production equipment moves vertically by servo.
GMF-C station options, side-operated magazines, servo-controlled adjustments, eight-wide configuration, and filling/closing hardware vocabulary.
references.note: Search-indexed text was available; the host denied direct PDF download during this asset build.

references.use: Legacy GMF silhouette and confirmation of the eight-wide slatted conveyor, servo container insertion, filler, ejector, and double-size slat options.
Installed-generation context for large-inclusion filling, spinner filling, and side-loaded magazines.

recognizableFeatures: Long open stainless skid with a slatted eight-wide conveyor and large end-drive covers.
Four primary uprights supporting a long integrated top electrical cabinet and station rail.
Side-loaded multi-rod cup or cone magazine at the infeed.
Bank of eight servo/pneumatic filler cylinders with blue product tubes.
Central operator HMI with emergency stop and push buttons.
Central multi-head filling or decoration station and a conical dry-topping hopper.
Downstream closing station, visible cups in slats, wash pan, adjustable feet, and tall utility stack.

confidence.area: Current operator-side silhouette and station identity
confidence.note: The official isolated render is large and detailed, but it shows only one configured machine from a single three-quarter direction.
The dimensions are image-derived estimates. Replace them when an installation or general-arrangement drawing is available.

confidence.note: Relative placement follows the current manufacturer render. Small hardware and pipe routes are simplified for QC-floor readability.

confidence.area: Far side, internal mechanisms, exact lane count for the installed factory revision, and utilities
